This looks like the object the compress backend is wrapping `nil` for some reason.

I can't see an obvious reason for this.

Can you make a way I can reproduce this please?

Is there a particular object which is corrupted somehow?

Can you reproduce with

    rclone lsl compress-crypt-rsync-net:backup-pungent/images

I don't think much has changed in the compress backend, but it would be worth trying [the latest beta](https://beta.rclone.org/) for completeness sake.

@buengese any other ideas?

Yeah, sorry, no idea how to go about reproducing it. FWIW the workload is rsync'ing fairly big files (20-100GB) into the mount.

The box this is happening on isn't exactly the most stable one historically, so I could imagine stuff crashing or getting killed mid-operation in the past. [compress-crypt-rsync-net]
type = compress
remote = crypt-rsync-net:compress

```

issue.title: Metadata is not being sync’d, maybe related to --s3-decompress

repository.name: rclone
repository.description: "rsync for cloud storage" - Google Drive, S3, Dropbox, Backblaze B2, One Drive, Swift, Hubic, Wasabi, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob, Azure Files, Yandex Files

issue.body:
#### What is the problem you are having with rclone?

Metadata is no longer synchronised with 1.60.0.

This works using the `-M/--metadata` parameter in 1.59.2 (see the log in the Gist below). This may be related to the `--s3-decompress` parameter which now also needs to be used and apparently had a bug regarding [metadata](https://github.com/rclone/rclone/issues/6434).

#### What is your rclone version (output from `rclone version`)

```
rclone v1.60.0
- os/version: debian 11.5 (64 bit)
- os/kernel: 5.18.0-0.deb11.4-amd64 (x86_64)
- os/type: linux
- os/arch: amd64
- go/version: go1.19.2
- go/linking: static
- go/tags: none
```

#### Which OS you are using and how many bits (e.g. Windows 7, 64 bit)

Debian 11, 64 Bit

#### Which cloud storage system are you using? (e.g. Google Drive)

Netapp StorageGrid (S3 compatible)

#### The command you were trying to run (e.g. `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

```
rclone sync -M --s3-decompress test-bucket:test-bucket-et-created/ test-bucket-et-created_post_restore
```

#### A log from the command with the `-vv` flag (e.g. output from `rclone -vv copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

https://gist.github.com/manzsolutions-lpr/a8bcad93cbf28fab531db0a83f3a1c32

#### How to use GitHub

* Please use the 👍 [reaction](https://blog.github.com/2016-03-10-add-reactions-to-pull-requests-issues-and-comments/) to show that you are affected by the same issue.
* Please don't comment if you have no relevant information to add. It's just extra noise for everyone subscribed to this issue.
* Subscribe to receive notifications on status change and new comments.
